name: SIE - Cambio automático de estado de pedido

parameters.query:
WITH successful AS (
  SELECT integration_status
  FROM public.integration_logs
  WHERE event_id = $1
    AND integration_status IN ('completed', 'already_processed')
  LIMIT 1
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE public.orders
  SET order_status = $3, integrated_at = now()
  WHERE order_id = $2
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM successful)
  RETURNING order_id
),
logged AS (
  INSERT INTO public.integration_logs (
    event_id, event_type, order_id, workflow_name, execution_id,
    integration_status, error_type, error_message, created_at
  )
  SELECT
    $1, 'order.status_changed', $2,
    'SIE - Cambio automático de estado de pedido', $4,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN 'completed' ELSE 'pending_sync' END,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN NULL ELSE 'order_not_found' END,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN NULL ELSE 'El pedido todavía no existe en el back-office' END,
    now()
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM successful)
  RETURNING integration_status
)
SELECT 'already_processed'::text AS integration_status FROM successful
UNION ALL
SELECT integration_status FROM logged
LIMIT 1;
